remarks: PRICED TO SELL! Located in the Hamburg/Lakeview, NY area this property features two separate lots totaling 10 acres. The largest part of 7 acres features the ranch style house that's 1160sqft, has 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, laundry room, no basement with a 4 car attached garage, additional buildings, office, extra storage and pond. The additional 3 acres features the pond and is clean land with no structures located on it could be a perfect opportunity to build your family home (Tax i.d. 144889-194-000-0003-112). (Seller may be willing to sell separately). The total frontage with both lots combined are around 1000ft+ and the depth is 900ft. (see photos for land/property layout). School district is Frontier, Property is septic and taxes are only $5240 a year. Many opportunities await the next owner for this amazing property that was formerly a landscaping and nursery business. This property is zoned 280-17 through 280-23. Seller may consider private financing.
